div.t-attf-class: o_dashboard_card chart-card theme-{{props.data ? (props.data.color_theme || 'primary') : 'primary'}} h-100 d-flex flex-column

div.t-attf-style: {{props.data && props.data.custom_color ? 'background-color: ' + props.data.custom_color + '18; color: ' + props.data.custom_color + ' !important; border-color: ' + props.data.custom_color + '40;' : ''}}

button.class: btn btn-sm bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-pill px-3 py-1 text-[11px] font-bold cursor-pointer transition-all
button.title: Xem danh sách bản ghi

span.class: badge bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 border border-slate-200 rounded-pill px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-mono font-bold
